I tried turning off the noise cancelling feature and I couldn't hear the audio book at all. I bought these for upcoming air travel and I think they are going to work very well. Finally, I think they have excellent sound quality, both with the noise canceling turned off or on. I'm not an audiophile, I listen to some music but I use more often for audiobooks. text_fidelity_a:
WiFi Video Projector, WEWATCH V10B Wireless Portable Movie Projector with Bluetooth Full HD 1080P Supported Home Theater Video Projector Compatible with HDMI, VGA, TV Stick, iPhone, Android The WEWATCH V30 Portable Projector is a good 1080p projector for its size. I watched some movies with the screen setup to 80-90 inches and the picture looked very good in a dark room. It's important to watch this projector in low ambient lighting due to its low ANSI lumens, as bright light will wash out the picture.

The size of the projector is not as small as the pictures make it seem. Though it is not advertised as a pico projector, I expected it to be smaller. With that said, the projector is not so large that it would be hard to transport or store when not in use.

Unfortunately, I was not able to get the Wi-Fi feature to work with my Iphone. This is not a dealbreaker for me, as I plugged a Roku stick into the HDMI port and the system worked well.

I was surprised by how good the native speakers sound. I found watching movies enjoyable and voices were easy to hear. There are adjustments for the bass and treble levels in the menus. The unit has a headphone jack in the rear which makes hooking up an external speaker set up a breeze.

The fan on the unit is very quiet and is not distracting while it is in use.

While I really like this projector, there is a large downside. The lack of keystone correction is a huge oversight. Placing this projector without keystone adjustment means the projector has to be directly in line with the viewing area making it necessary to use a tripod in most instances. Having to bring a tripod along, makes the unit less portable.

Overall, this is a small projector with a great picture, as long as you can place it in the perfect location without much ambient lighting. If WEWATCH added keystone correction and refined the mirroring feature, this would be a 5 star projector.
text_fidelity_b: WiFi Video Projector, WEWATCH V10B Wireless Portable Movie Projector with Bluetooth Full HD 1080P Supported Home Theater Video Projector Compatible with HDMI, VGA, TV Stick, iPhone, Android

text_fidelity_a:
Webcam with Microphone for Desktop - CESCOM 3MP USB Camera for Computer, HD Streaming Web Cam, 110 Degree Wide Angle Sharp Image, Plug and Play Design, Automatic Noise Reduction, Ideal for Laptop, PC So, let me start off by saying, this isn't the best quality webcam on the market. But for the price, no one is expecting it to be. And it is FAR from the worst! During the Covid Pandemic, all the regular brand name webcams were sold out so I found myself trying out a bunch of these no-name brands from Amazon. The last one I tried actually had a much harsher fisheye effect in the corners, as well as over-saturated color. This one seems far less cartoony and more realistic in color reproduction, as well as being somewhat more rectilinear (photo speak for straight lines being straight, not as much curved distortion). There is a bit of fisheye curve on the edges, but it is very usable and didn't make my ceiling look concave like my last one I tried. See attached images for examples of the room's wall distortion. It's there if you are looking for it, but not terrible when you're looking at a subject. The microphone is just meh. I have a desktop mic and the sound out of that was MUCH better, especially because you can get it closer to your face than the camera. But the fact that this HAS a mic is a good option in a pinch. I would just strongly recommend an external mic if you want people to hear you clearly. Also something I didn't know before trying this:
It is MANUAL focus! That means it won't follow and focus on you automatically, you have to twist the lens until you're sharp in the view. It actually isn't that hard to nail focus, the depth of focus is pretty deep so once you've set it for your standard sitting distance, you likely won't have to change it ever again unless you walk away from the camera. A fun side effect, however is that the focus lens gear lets you push it to EXTREME MACRO distances! So you can do insane closeups of things if you want to, for example, put a webcam on an ant farm maybe? I tried it out on my desktop speaker, and in one picture you can see the relative size of it compared to my desk and then the closeup you can see the detail of the scratched plastic where it says Harmon / Kardon. Ha, if nothing else this shows me I should probably get new desktop speakers too! These are beat up when up close! A fun and versatile camera for a good price. If you need autofocus tracking, this might not be for you though.
text_fidelity_b: Webcam with Microphone for Desktop - CESCOM 3MP USB Camera for Computer, HD Streaming Web Cam, 110 Degree Wide Angle Sharp Image, Plug and Play Design, Automatic Noise Reduction, Ideal for Laptop, PC

text_fidelity_a:
CTVISION 4K 8MP Home Business Wired Security Camera Systems,8-Channel 4K 8MP PoE Network Video Recorder(4TB HDD),8pc 4K (4X1080P) Outdoor Dome PoE IP Camera,Free App,P2P Cloud,Onvif,Video Surveillance [[VIDEOID:5b880a1d8f11ab783ee7340a330164be]] I ordered the ‘CTVISION 4K 8MP Home Business Wired Security Camera Systems,8-Channel 4K 8MP PoE Network Video Recorder(4TB HDD),8pc 4K (4X1080P) Outdoor Dome PoE IP Camera,Free App,P2P Cloud,Onvif,Video Surveillance’ for review and would like to share my thoughts.

I will lay this out as pros and cons and give some final thoughts.

Pros: The kit as a whole is well made.
Cameras are well made.
The 4tb hard drive is a good name brand and seems to be performing quite well.
The video quality is good.
The kit comes with 8X good quality 50 foot CAT5 cables (more on this in the cons)

Cons: The included cables are only 50 feet each. In a home install, if you are trying to run cameras to all corners of your house, 50 feet is not long enough in my case. I only used three of these cables. I had to buy more cable (CAT6) for the longer runs.
Although the cameras are well made, because they are of the Dome type, if you adjust the cameras to point at much of an angle, you run into issues at night when the IR lights turn on. This causes the IR lights to reflect back at the cameras (See attached video) The best angle for the cameras are to point straight down or at a very slight angle.
Speaking of angles, these cameras only have a 90 degree diagonal viewing angle which was a little disappointing.
When viewing the live feed, sometimes the video feed gets distorted for a couple of seconds.
The software of the NVR is a little overwhelming and hard to navigate. This is probably due to the fact that I have never used this type of system before. There are a lot of options in the Software which does not work with these specific cameras, such as Human Detection or PTZ (Pan Tilt Zoom). Not having the PTZ is really no big deal but it would have been nice to have the Human Detection so that the cameras don’t alarm when the wind blows the trees and shrubs.
There is an option to send an email when there is motion detected on the cameras but I was never able to get that to work.
Although there is an email option, I would have liked to see a text option.

Overall I am actually happy with this kit. It at least provides peace-of-mind knowing that the cameras are always recording and with the included 4tb hard drive in this kit, it provides many hours of footage. I hope that this was somewhat helpful.
text_fidelity_b: CTVISION 4K 8MP Home Business Wired Security Camera Systems,8-Channel 4K 8MP PoE Network Video Recorder(4TB HDD),8pc 4K (4X1080P) Outdoor Dome PoE IP Camera,Free App,P2P Cloud,Onvif,Video Surveillance

text_fidelity_a:
LeadsaiL Rechargeable Wireless Computer Mouse, 2.4G Portable Slim Cordless Mouse Less Noise for Laptop Optical Mouse with 5 Adjustable DPI Levels USB Mouse for Laptop, Deskbtop, MacBook I'll be honest, I was expecting this to be another cheap off-brand mouse. I'm pleasantly surprised at how good it is- It looks pretty great, and rather than being covered in shiny fingerprint-magnet plastic like most cheap mice, a majority of the surface is textured (almost like a rubberized plastic). The USB receiver fits inside the body of the mouse for storage, which is great for travelling with it as I do. I've owned other mice that did that before too (an old Logitech), but unlike that old Logitech, this one uses a built-in rechargeable battery. To be honest, my Logitech mouse was great but after a couple of years the battery started making a bad connection inside (corroded contacts were keeping the battery from working), so I'd have to try to clean it off every few uses on the road to keep it working. With this product however, it seems less likely that will become a problem. Also, the ability to plug it in and charge it off the computer directly if it starts to die is a great plus!
My first impression was that the mouse was a little jumpier than I expected, but then I noticed the little button under the scroll wheel and discovered that it was for changing the DPI. Honestly, I'm not sure why they put it in such an easy to use spot, I feel like this isn't something that needs to change very often. But a couple of clicks on that button got me to about the mouse speed I like. I'm actually really happy with this product and although I was shopping around for a replacement Logitech, I think I'll keep this one in my travel bag instead!
text_fidelity_b: LeadsaiL Rechargeable Wireless Computer Mouse, 2.4G Portable Slim Cordless Mouse Less Noise for Laptop Optical Mouse with 5 Adjustable DPI Levels USB Mouse for Laptop, Deskbtop, MacBook

The drive has a cap-less design with a rotating case to protect the drive, thus providing durability and convenience. I use this to save Word/Excel files, pictures and short videos.

I have used 8 GB drives and the problem with them is that the free space gets filled fast with long videos. The 32 GB or higher storage capacity flash drives help solve this little problem. Some reviewers have complained that the drive is faulty, but I never had any such problems. I do caution that this USB-2 interface is slow to transfer/paste large files. This problem is inherent in the USB-2 protocol. If the transfer speed is important to you, then I suggest a USB-3 thumb drive.

text_fidelity_a:
PNY 128GB Elite Class 10 U1 microSDXC Flash Memory Card, Model:P-SDU128U185EL-GE Although I am technically experienced and have built my own computer systems, programmed and done a lot of tech work, when it comes to my tablet, I like to be easy and mindless. Sounds contradictory, but that is just the way it is for me at the moment. What I wanted was some extra space on my Samsung Galaxy Tab S2 to put pictures and apps so that my tablet could still work with good speed. I like to keep my storage to about half to allow the operating system room to go without being bogged down.

HOW DID THIS CARD PERFORM FOR ME?
I do not take the time to do fancy testing to the microsecond, so if you want that kind of information, please do check the other reviews. Some excellent reviewers have taken the time to post test results on their systems that they are using this card with.

For me, I tested this within my tablet, moving apps and photos to the card and the speed was great. I also tested it with taking photos of various sizes and video and again, I was very happy with the speed. I transferred some files from my desktop and it went at a decent clip and I was again happy with the adapter and the card.

I have had no hiccups as of yet, errors, or other problems, but will update as I have experiences to add about this card.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Is this a top of the line card that will give you blazing speed at the drop of a hat? No. Is this a card with great speed for a decent price? Yes. For use in my tablet, I have had no issues with it, the speeds were decent, and the adapter worked well on my desktop. I give this five stars for value and performance.
text_fidelity_b: PNY 128GB Elite Class 10 U1 microSDXC Flash Memory Card, Model:P-SDU128U185EL-GE

FLAGTOP 7 in 1 USB C Hub for Universal Devices, Support 4K HDMI/PD 3.0 / USB 3.0 / 2USB 2.0 / SD/Micro SD/TF, USB Type C Dongle Hub (02A) I have a 2017 MacBook Pro with 4 Thunderbolt/USB C ports. Of course almost every peripheral I use is USB 2.0/3.0, so I have adapters everywhere and can never find one when I need it, or don’t have enough ports to plug in everything I want to use.

So this USB C Hub from Flagtop is super handy to have around. I use it to connect a second monitor (HDMI port), an external mouse/keyboard (USB 2.0 ports), and the power cable (USB C port).

I like that the USB 2.0/USB 3.0 ports have a little space between each one. This makes them usable even if you have a thick thumb drive or cable plugged in.

I had to have the ports on my laptop replaced because they loosened up over time, so I like that I can reduce wear on the new ports by unplugging the hub to disconnect everything.

The port runs warm. It’s hot to the touch; my desk feels warm underneath it.

I do wish the cable for the hub was longer. If I have my laptop on a stand, the hub dangles from one of the ports. The cable is about 5.5 inches, and if I have several things plugged into it, I feel like that’s a lot of weight to have hanging off a single port on the side of my laptop.

Lenovo Legion Y720 Gaming Laptop, 15.6" Full HD, Intel Core i7-7700HQ Processor, 16GB DDR4 RAM, 512GB SSD, GeForce GTX 1060-6GB, Windows 10 Signature Image - 80VR0078US Like all dedicated gaming laptops, this is a big heavy high-powered machine. It is portable enough to lug over to your buddy's house for play dates, but it is too bulky and heavy to carry to work everyday. Construction is very good with an aggressive-looking aluminum case to match the aggressive-sounding "Legion" product name. Mechanical keyboard has decent (but not the best) travel and the large keys are backlit so you can easily play your games in the dark. Dolby Atmos audio works well for games, but is kind of thin for music or movies unless you hook it up to external speakers. This Y720 version has a 1080p IPS display, which is OK but not as bright or contrasty as some other laptops I have used. There is also a more expensive 4K display available, but I have not tried that.

Core i7 CPU with 16GB of RAm gives you really great performance. This machine is easily powerful enough for any games I tried on it. Even though performance is throttled somewhat when run off the battery, battery life is still less than 2 hours under heavy use (maybe 6 hours with light use).

For the money, it is hard to go wrong with these Lenovo Legions. If you don't want to spend more than $1000, the cheaper Legion Y520 is almost as good for most types of games and costs $300 less.
text_fidelity_b: Lenovo Legion Y720 Gaming Laptop, 15.6" Full HD, Intel Core i7-7700HQ Processor, 16GB DDR4 RAM, 512GB SSD, GeForce GTX 1060-6GB, Windows 10 Signature Image - 80VR0078US

text_fidelity_a:
Microsoft Wireless All-In-One Media Keyboard,Black - Wireless Keyboard with Track Pad. USB Wireless Receiver. Spill Resistant Design. 2AAA Batteries Included. Most people purchase this wireless keyboard to use at home with their TV or other media setup. I actually purchased it to use at work as a more ergonomic option. No, this is not billed as an ergonomic keyboard, but the main issue I was having was reaching for the mouse, so I wanted something with a built-in trackpad. Surprisingly, there are VERY FEW options available, particularly within a reasonable price range (<50) and offered by a name brand company.

Prior to purchasing this keyboard, I tried another which featured the trackpad front and center ([[ASIN:B004KN7PZG Gear Head USB Smart Touch II Touchpad Keyboard]]). Unfortunately, that product was way too glitchy, and the size was not ideal. I thought that the center trackpad would work well given that I'm used to using one on my laptop at home (a [[ASIN:B00IPQXZ62 Dell XPS Convertible 2 in 1]], which has a near-ideal keyboard), but that did not seem to be the case. When I began looking for keyboards with a built-in trackpad on the side, this one by Microsoft seemed to be the only viable option, although I wasn't looking for wireless.

I did like that that the keyboard is Microsoft, and I like the clean look and design. Compared to the prior keyboard that I tried, this one definitely has a more comfortable feel. Although it is small, there is adequate spacing around the keys, something the prior keyboard lacked. There is no number pad--the trackpad replaces this--but as I never used this anyway, this is no loss for me. All of the keys are a nice size, including the shift keys (these are sometimes skimped upon). Unfortunately, there is no "End" key--I knew that upon purchasing, but I still miss it. What I did NOT realize is that in order to access the Function keys, you actually have to HOLD DOWN the "FN" button. This is a bit of a pain for me, as I use Refresh (F5) constantly, so this is now a 2-handed operation. This keyboard is also missing any kind of indicator for CAPS LOCK.

The trackpad is okay. I still have my mouse plugged in, and unfortunately, I find myself using it too often, as the trackpad is not completely reliable. It does accept multi-finger scrolling gestures, which is nice, and it does pretty well with simple up-down navigation; however, I have found that side-to-side is much more uneven. I do like that there is a left-hand click button on the right side of the keyboard, and I have made use of this at times. But I've also found that sometimes my palm randoming activates the trackpad when I am typing, causing the cursor to flip to a new spot on screen, which is annoying. So, at best, this has been just average.

This keyboard includes other features that I don't use--e.g., a volume control, a separate mute button (are both necessary?), home and other "hot" keys, etc. I'm assuming that these extras would be more beneficial to someone using the keyboard in a home media setting. For my needs, this keyboard has been okay. The layout is decent, although it could have been much, much better with a few minor changes. Depending on how you plan to use it, I would recommend it with reservations.
text_fidelity_b: Microsoft Wireless All-In-One Media Keyboard,Black - Wireless Keyboard with Track Pad. USB Wireless Receiver. Spill Resistant Design. 2AAA Batteries Included.

text_fidelity_a:
Seagate 600 SSD 480 GB SATA 6 Gb/s 2.5-Inch 7mm Z-Height Solid State Drive ST480HM000 Though I have a laptop, I decided to use this solid-state drive as a boot drive on my desktop computer. If you are unfamiliar with the difference between a solid-state and a regular hard drive, the solid-state has no moving parts, which makes it silent, fast, reliable, and shock resistant. It has twice the capacity and twice the speed of the solid-state drive I got a couple of years ago for the same price, and blows away a standard drive for speed.

Given the silence and speed, it makes a great boot drive for running Windows, Photoshop, and other programs where speed is a huge advantage. Just to give you an idea, when upgrading from a regular two-year-old hard drive to this solid-state drive, my Windows boot time went from two minutes to about 10 seconds. Seriously, my computer now starts up and is ready to use in like 10 seconds.

What I do is use a solid-state drive as my boot drive and a regular hard drive as a storage drive. Solid-state drives like this are really expensive to purchase if you need any kind of capacity, but a 200 GB drive will certainly hold all of your programs and often used files.

As for this drive specifically, I hooked it up to my desktop and it was immediately recognized by Windows. The drivers installed automatically. In order to make the drive show up as a drive and work in Windows 7, I had to right-click on computer, click manage, double-click storage, double-click disk management, partition it, give it a drive letter, and format it.

As I said, it's a lot faster than the solid-state drive I had from a couple years ago, and there's no problem using it on my desktop machine rather than my laptop.
text_fidelity_b: Seagate 600 SSD 480 GB SATA 6 Gb/s 2.5-Inch 7mm Z-Height Solid State Drive ST480HM000

Soundcore Anker Spirit X2, Wireless Earphones, Body-Moving Bass, IP68 Sweatproof, 36H Playtime,Fast Charge, Secure Earhooks, Bluetooth 5, CVC 8.0 Clear Calls, Sports Earphones for Gym, Sport, Jogging When I first tried the earphones with the default ear tips, the sound was very "tinny". Highs, vocals, no discernible bass. Then when I was testing out the controls, I lightly pushed the earphones in my ear and wow - bass. I then replaced the ear tips with the larger ones in the set. Now they fit snug but comfortable. The sound is great. Bass is clear.

I use "Enter Sandman" by Metallica as one of my test songs. Cymbals = highs, vocals for mid, and great percussion for bass. The sound was fantastic, similar to my Sennheiser HD 280 pro.... Sennheiser is clearly better, but for small form factor earphones, Anker Soundcore Spirit X2 are a pleasure to use.

text_fidelity_a:
Vanguard VEO2GO235AB Aluminum Travel Tripod with VEO GO34M BK Shoulder Bag ordered the ‘Vanguard VEO2GO235AB Aluminum Travel Tripod with VEO GO34M BK Shoulder Bag’ for review and would like to share my thoughts. I will list the Pros and Cons for each, the Shoulder Bag and Tripod.

Shoulder Bag
Pros:
It is of great quality with sufficient padding throughout.
It comes with a rain cover in the back zipper pocket that is attached to an elastic cord which can be removed.
The Tripod fits nicely into the bottom zipper compartment.

Cons:
I don’t really like the design.
Not many pockets nor compartments.
My DSLR won’t fit properly in the main compartment with a medium sized lens attached. (See images)
The Shoulder strap is not removable.

Tripod
Pros:
It’s very compact!
It’s seems to be of good quality and performs very well.
It’s pretty stable when fully extended.
Center post can be inverted to where the camera can mount hanging upside down for very low angle shots.
It has a hook on the bottom of the center post to hang some weight from for more stability under windy conditions.
The rubber leg adjustment knobs work well and make for easy leg extension and breaking down.
It comes with metal spikes which can be added to the bottom of the legs for a more secure footing. I installed these and slid the rubber boots over them so if I need the spikes, they are as easy as just pulling the boots off to use.
The included Ball Head is nice.

Cons:
It’s a bit on the heavy side.
I don’t like the camera to Ball Head attachment. There is a metal spring loaded pin that does not seem to work for the included camera attachment which makes it not so easy to remove the camera from the Ball Head mount. You have to nearly unscrew the bracket all the way to get the camera off and it is a bit annoying.

Overall I do think this kit of great value but if I were to buy this, I would not get it with the bag. Please see the attached images.
text_fidelity_b: Vanguard VEO2GO235AB Aluminum Travel Tripod with VEO GO34M BK Shoulder Bag
